summary: DueByte 0.3.65 permits preparation of the first tariff without advance notice only on a clean, never-funded zero-supply chain. Subsequent tariff changes retain advance notice. All signatures and consensus checks remain required. The approved fee stays 0.06 percent with a 0.005 DUBYT minimum at the USD1 reference. Installing this release does not activate a tariff. Installation does not issue tokens, submit funding, start warmup or activate exchange. Existing chain, wallet keys, balances and signing history are retained. Home64 updates automatically; Linux Server requires coordinated manual installation. Windows executable is not Microsoft-code-signed; verify the signed DueByte channel. The candidate notice inside the immutable archive is superseded by this release notice.
